prompt: `<Greeting name="Ana" minutes="45" />` fails to type-check. Why?

choices.text: `"45"` is a string, and `minutes` is a number
choices.why: Right: write `minutes={45}`.

choices.text: `name` must be in braces
choices.why: A string prop may be quoted.

choices.text: Components may not be used before they are defined in the same file
choices.why: Order in the file is not the problem here.

choices.text: A component cannot take two props

prompt: Why is a bold word written as a `Text` inside a `Text`, rather than three `Text` elements in a row in a `View`?

choices.text: A `View` cannot hold more than one `Text`
choices.why: It can hold many.

choices.text: It stays one paragraph: one native text view that wraps and is read as one
choices.why: Right; three boxes would wrap separately and be read as three items.

choices.text: Three separate elements render faster on Android, but the nested form is more readable for whoever maintains the code
choices.why: Speed is not the point, and the claim is not what the section says.

choices.text: `fontWeight` works only on nested text
choices.why: It works on any Text.

prompt: `{count && <Text>{count} sessions</Text>}` inside a `View` works in every test, then fails for one user. What is that user's `count`?

Right: `0 && …` is `0`, a number rendered as text in a View.

choices.text: `undefined`, because the user has no sessions yet
choices.why: `undefined` renders as nothing.

choices.text: A very large number that overflows the row
choices.why: Size is not the error here.

prompt: Padding was put in a ScrollView's `style`, and the content scrolls underneath it. What was meant?

choices.text: `paddingTop` on the first child only, with nothing on the ScrollView
choices.why: That pads one element, not the content around all of them.

choices.text: A `View` around the ScrollView with the same padding
choices.why: That pads the window again.

choices.text: `contentContainerStyle`
choices.why: Right: padding around the content, which scrolls with it.

choices.text: `margin` instead of `padding`
choices.why: Margin is also outside the content.

prompt: A ScrollView shows 800 sessions, and the screen takes seconds to appear. What is the cause?

choices.text: The keyboard is open
choices.why: The keyboard has nothing to do with it.

choices.text: `contentContainerStyle` is missing
